name: Elke Folkersma
bio: Elke Folkersma is a writer at 24high with a broad interest in health, nutrition and supplements. She brings complex topics to life in accessible and inspiring articles.

Elke writes for 24high on various topics within health and well-being. With her fresh writing style and eye for detail, she manages to convey substantive themes in a clear and lively way, making articles both informative and enjoyable to read.In her work, Elke combines her love of language with a curious and open mind. This results in structured articles with a positive approach, in which readers find reliable and accessible information that supports making conscious choices around nutrition, supplements and a healthy lifestyle.

Red Vein, Green Vein or White Vein kratom: what exactly is the difference? Although these varieties come from the same kratom plant, they are associated with different characteristics. Find out what the names mean, how the varieties differ from one another and what to look out for when choosing kratom.

name: Mirjam Sprenger
bio: Mirjam Sprenger is a copywriter at 24high with a strong focus on health, nutrition and supplements. She translates complex topics into clear and accessible articles, based on careful research.

Mirjam writes for 24high on a variety of topics within health and well-being. Her strength lies in making substantive and sometimes complex topics understandable, without losing nuance or care. In her articles, she combines reliable sources with a calm and accessible writing style. Thus, she helps readers to be well informed and make conscious choices within topics such as nutrition, supplements and a healthy lifestyle.

Starting your studies well prepared after the summer holidays? With the right routine, sufficient rest and conscious habits, you can support your focus and energy balance. Discover 4 practical tips to help you get back into your study rhythm and start the new academic year productively.

name: Rianne Gerrits
bio: Rianne is a writer at 24high with extensive experience in communications, marketing and storytelling. She knows how to translate complex topics into understandable and people-oriented content.

Rianne has been active in communications and marketing for over a decade and uses her experience to make topics around health and well-being clear and accessible. Her strength lies in conveying content in a human and understandable way, without unnecessary complexity.Her articles for 24high focus on sharing honest and down-to-earth information. With a clear, simple writing style and a touch of edginess, she aims to inform, inspire and invite readers to look at their own well-being in a conscious way.
Do you want to prepare properly for a truffle trip? Find out why nutrition, rest, set and setting, and a clear mindset are important for a mindful experience.

name: Stoney Tark
bio: Stoney Tark is a prolific writer from Europe, known for his articles on growing, breeding and making hashish, interviews and especially his best tips. Over the past 11 years, he has become one of the industry's most recognised writers.

Head writer for cultivation for Soft Secrets Magazine, as well as his work for High Times Magazine, Skunk Magazine, Garden Culture Magazine, Weed World Magazine, The Emerald, Grow Magazine, Cannabis Culture Magazine, Dutch Passion, The Super Sativa Seed Club, Paradise Seeds, Humboldt Seed Organization, Atami and ILGM.

Stoney is also a breeder for Prana Medical Seeds, sponsored by SANlight, an author of Stoney Tark’s Top Tips on Growing Cannabis available on Amazon, and a brand ambassor and faculty member with Oaksterdam University.
